verdict.rationale: Postman hosts a live llms.txt file at learning.postman.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200) and supports .md-suffixed pages for clean markdown consumption, directly enabling agents to fetch agent-oriented docs; docs also explicitly note giving coding agents Postman CLI context for API discovery and maintenance tasks. Missing for 10: independent/third-party confirmation of agents actually using llms.txt in the wild.
